text:
alex: Quick heads-up — I'm going to enable the small canary for the speculative-decoding v2 path + KV-cache prefetch tweak across one podpool in us-west-2 at 18:40 UTC. Canary size = 1% traffic. Putting this here so we don't step on any other rollouts.

nina: ack. which flag keys are you flipping? can you paste the feature flag cfg?

alex: sure — toggles in FF service are `spec_decode_v2` and `kv_prefetch_v1`. snippet: ```yaml
feature: spec_decode_v2
enabled: true
audience:
  type: percentage
  value: 1
overrides:
  regions: [us-west-2]
  podpool: canary-3
---
feature: kv_prefetch_v1
enabled: true
audience:
  type: percentage
  value: 1
```

brian: quick note — p95 latched up during the last spec-decode deploy in eu-central for long-context tests. please keep an eye on p50/p95 and the kernel-fallback rate. set the alert threshold lower for the canary.

priya: +1 on extra alarms. I'll create a temporary SLO watch for this canary with tighter thresholds (p95 > 450ms). tagging @sarah to update the runbook hitters.

sarah: got it — runbook updated. fallback steps: 1) flip `spec_decode_v2` off, 2) set `kv_prefetch_v1` to false, 3) re-route canary traffic to spec_decode_v1. I'll add the exact commands to the doc.

alex: thanks. also enabling kernel-level guardrail: if `kernel-fallback-rate` > 5%/min then auto-disable `spec_decode_v2`. ops config: `auto_disable_on_fallback: true` with a 60s window.

nina: please also add a model-variant fallback in the routing policy so requests can hit the smaller quantized variant if latency spikes. we don't want to fail open to the host model.

alex: done, routing policy updated to drop to `redwood-small-q4` when fallback triggers.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary toggle patch applied by alex in staging -> production-canary (patch id=pr-4921). CI: green.

brian: watching dashboards now. can someone link the canary dashboard? can't find the new panel in the runtime cluster view.

priya: dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/eng-runtime/canary/1815032468 — added panels for p50/p95, kernel-fallback-rate, kv-hit-rate, and request-per-second.

alex: thanks — rolling start is at :00 and I'll check back in 10m. if no regressions I'll step to 5% after 30m.

sarah: reminder — please message customer-incident channel if fallback rate > 10% even for transient spikes. keeps CS in the loop.

brian: seeing a small bump in kv-miss rate, but p95 still within threshold. will report after 15m.

priya: adding a short postmortem checkpoint in case we flip back. who owns the rollback? alex?

alex: I can own rollback. if we need to flip both toggles off: run `ffctl set spec_decode_v2 false` and `ffctl set kv_prefetch_v1 false` and then abort canary in the console. I'll coordinate.

nina: thanks — also please ping me for a quick CR to the spec-decode telemetry to add a correlation tag for the kv-prefetch id (helps trace issues).

alex: will do. back in 8m with status. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
